title: Null-Space Steering vs Adaptive Attacks: A Cheap Adaptive-Evaluation Stress Test

original_idea.body: Null-space steering vs adaptive attacks (extends NullSteer arXiv:2603.22094): implement simplified null-space refusal steering, evaluate static then cheap adaptive attacker, report static-vs-adaptive ASR gap.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Quantifying the static-vs-adaptive gap is the crux of a named open problem; strong, concrete chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Simplified null-space steering + cheap adaptive attacker; both add modest implementation depth.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused static-vs-adaptive ASR-gap deliverable; implementing both sides is bounded.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Reusable adaptive stress-test protocol, open model, no lab resources.

novelty.reasoning: Adaptive stress test of null-space steering rarely done; mostly novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Adaptive evaluation of null-space steering missing.
